diagnosticDefinitions.stalledTicks: Alive, steering (|x|+|y| >= 0.5) without dash, shield, lunge or knockback on each of the last 15 ticks, yet never more than 15 units from where the window began. Counts wall pushing and tight jitter; a wide back-and-forth around an obstacle is missed.
diagnosticDefinitions.noSightTicks: Both alive and the centre-to-centre segment crosses a wall. Counted for every move, including lobs and aim-point placements that can act without a direct line.
diagnosticDefinitions.idleTicks: Alive with a live opponent, moved under 0.5 units this tick and neither attacking nor in an attack, channel or swipe. Includes steering into a wall and deliberate waiting.
diagnosticDefinitions.longestIdleTicks: Longest consecutive run of idle ticks.
diagnosticDefinitions.edgeTicks: Alive within 45 units of the playable arena boundary; diagnostic, not a penalty.
diagnosticDefinitions.cornerTicks: Alive within 45 units of two boundaries.
diagnosticDefinitions.damageDealt: Health damage from hit events this fighter owned against the opponent.
diagnosticDefinitions.damageTaken: Health damage from all hit events on this fighter, including self-damage.

loadout.name: put autoturret
counterplay: Destroy the turret (20 health) during its 15-tick arming delay or between shots.
Its bolts fire on a fixed half-second cadence; sidestep or hide behind walls.
loadout.balanceReason: A planted turret commits a 10-tick windup and 4-second cooldown, then fires only five slow-cadence 7-damage bolts over three seconds. It is fragile, telegraphed by its arming delay and blocked by walls.

loadout.name: im james blake
counterplay: The serve travels in a straight readable line; sidestep it or shield the single impact.
After at most two wall bounces it keeps a fixed path, so watch the rebound angle near walls.
loadout.balanceReason: A single fast tennis-ball serve with a short windup, moderate impact damage, two predictable wall rebounds and a cooldown between serves.

loadout.name: bounce missile
counterplay: The missile reflects off walls at most twice and explodes on the third wall or on a player; track its angles and step off the line.
Shoot down the fragile missile or dash out of the briefly marked blast circle; returning ricochets can also hurt its caster.
loadout.balanceReason: One slow, destructible ricochet projectile with a bounded bounce count and lifetime, a short warned blast of moderate damage, windup, recovery and cooldown, plus self damage risk on rebounds.

loadout.name: homing smg
counterplay: Bullets turn only gradually and are slower than normal gunfire; sharp sidesteps or dashes make them overshoot.
Solid cover blocks the stream, and each fragile round can be shot down or absorbed by a shield.
After 16 rounds the gun must reload for 2.5 seconds, opening a window to push in.
loadout.balanceReason: Low per-round damage with slow, gently curving, destructible bullets and a short 220 acquisition radius. A finite 16-round magazine and long reload limit sustained pressure, while cover and lateral movement still beat the homing.
